medical_precaution_body: Do not take unprescribed antibiotics or heavy prescription painkillers without a doctor's examination. Common viral issues generally improve with warm fluids, gargles, steam, and rest. If symptoms worsen, or fever persists past 3 days, consult a verified physician.
